_comment: Non-copyrighted preservation manifest and bounded findings for the three-row Phase-4 yellow-plant weapon batch; frame boundaries are not exact writer evidence.
bounded_conclusions: All four unique relevant capsules reconstruct under the exact pinned reader without a record-count or domain-hash error.
B11 and B12 retain distinct action-2/raw-u16-0x24 contact signatures at named actor-HP boundaries while their enemy quota values remain constant.
The shared yellow capsule retains both a quota-changing first type-11 episode and a no-quota-change second episode; the dedicated B13 capsule is a negative frame-domain observation.
Frame-boundary correlation does not attribute an exact CPU writer, projectile owner, target selector, collision callback, fuse, DMA/GPU/SPU producer, or causal control.

B11_blue_berry_shooter.bounded_observation: The dedicated capsule retains a type-14 plant from frame 42, raw-u16-0x24 value 110/action-2 contact state at the frame-398 actor HP boundary, and a constant quota. This is frame-boundary correlation, not projectile ownership or hit-writer attribution.

B12_homing_shooter.bounded_observation: The dedicated capsule retains a type-13 plant from frame 288, raw-u16-0x24 value 124/action-2 contact state at two actor HP boundaries, and a constant quota. The passive frames do not prove homing, target selection, ownership, or the exact hit writer.

B13_mine_plant.bounded_observation: The shared yellow capsule retains two type-11 episodes: the first has a frame-1848 quota and actor-HP boundary and retires at frame 1852; the second retires without a quota boundary. The dedicated B13 capsule contains no type-11, quota, or actor-HP boundary. This contrast does not identify a fuse, proximity rule, enemy ownership, collision callback, or kill causality.
